RegistrationInfo.Description: W365 thin client VIABILITY TEST ONLY (SCRIPT-FREE, Oct 13 2026): can Task Scheduler subscribe to an Analytic channel at all? Trigger is UNFILTERED Event 1019 on Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-RDPClient/Analytic, action is rwinsta.exe console as LOCAL SYSTEM (same as the proven tasks). Built after Bruce found Event 1019 at wake on Oct 13 with ErrorCode=0x35b7, DisconnectReason=0x1208 and ErrorString stating the PC went to sleep. Gate 1 is import: Analytic/Debug channels are documented as unsupported for event subscriptions, so Task Scheduler may reject this at import - that rejection IS a result. Gate 2, only if it imports and fires: selectivity needs the EventData field names from the 1019 Details/XML view, which are not yet known, so do NOT deploy this unfiltered version beyond the pilot box - any 1019 error would log the user off.
